title: Turn a WiFi 7 Router into a 320Msps Software Defined Radio Receiver
summary: This project demonstrates how to repurpose a WiFi 7 router (based on Qualcomm Networking Pro 920 platform) into a 320Msps Software Defined Radio receiver by exploiting the router's built-in RF hardware and FPGA capabilities for signal processing.
problem_solved: Provides a low-cost solution for acquiring a high-performance SDR receiver by repurposing consumer-grade networking hardware instead of purchasing expensive dedicated SDR equipment.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative hardware repurposing that can save users thousands of dollars while achieving professional-grade 320Msps sampling rates for radio experimentation and signal analysis.
